title: Bridge maps server bugs and lock failures to 400 invalid
description: Found while fixing withLock (AB-04B20E2A368C). In serve.ts errorResponse, an error without a code property (TypeError/RangeError/ReferenceError, i.e. a server bug) falls through to 400 invalid, and a lock that cannot be acquired (BoardError 'Cannot lock') is also 400 invalid, though both are server-side failures. Also dead code there: try { JSON.parse } catch (e) { throw e; } and an unused const bytes.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Unexpected errors and lock failures answer 500 (code decided and documented in README Bridge section)
Client errors (bad JSON, validation) still answer 400 invalid
Dead code removed; tests cover each mapping
